cases.prompt: Deliver one authorized issue whose execution targets and proof are already deterministic.
expected: route the ticket to Implement
launch exactly one fresh implementer through the single-ticket route

cases.prompt: Start two children in an approved graph from a clean isolated integration worktree.
expected: use a unique fresh implementer for every ticket
name the child as the only executable scope and put its complete ticket first
include a minimum sufficient source-identified Parent context packet with a complete-PRD reference, repository policy, and bounded write scope
reserve all Git actions to root
forbidden: let a worker stage or commit
implement a full child on root

cases.prompt: Tickets A and B touch the same owner and proof resource; ticket C is natively blocked by B.
expected: sequence A and B
release C only after B and combined deterministic proof succeed
forbidden: launch A and B in one wave

cases.prompt: Two ready tickets have disjoint scopes and resources and separate worker worktrees. A finishes while B is still running.
expected: launch both fresh workers in isolated worktrees
integrate and prove A independently before its root checkpoint
recalculate readiness after A settles without waiting for unrelated B

cases.prompt: An approved graph spans two repositories with separate integration worktrees and baselines.
expected: keep an in-memory ledger keyed by stable repository identity
schedule each ticket only against its repository integration worktree, baseline, and checkpoints
keep proof ranges separate per repository
forbidden: imply one Git range across repositories

cases.prompt: A worker times out and a dependent worker returns stale behavioral validation.
expected: create no affected checkpoint commit
release no successor
report both blockers

cases.prompt: A wave completes successfully and its successor is ready.
expected: wait for worker proof
inspect the integrated diff on root
run affected behavioral checks and combined deterministic proof
commit a scoped root checkpoint naming the Parent and exact ticket issues before releasing the successor
forbidden: release the successor before the checkpoint

cases.prompt: Root crashes after combined proof but before the checkpoint commit begins.
expected: reread the worktree and Git
treat the ticket as uncommitted
release no successor until the full root gate is repeated
forbidden: infer a checkpoint from completed proof

cases.prompt: The root commit command may have succeeded, but its response was lost.
expected: reread Git before retrying
accept exactly one scoped checkpoint reachable from the pinned baseline whose message names the Parent and exact tickets

cases.prompt: The in-memory ledger is lost after a checkpoint response disappears in one repository of a two-repository graph.
expected: rebuild repository entries from authoritative sources and Git
record the uniquely rediscovered SHA in that repository checkpoint sequence and recovery_commits
release successors only from the reconstructed repository-scoped checkpoint

cases.prompt: A two-repository wave passes proof. Root confirms the checkpoint in repository A, but settlement is interrupted before repository B has a checkpoint; Git later confirms that B has no matching commit and its work may be missing.
expected: retain repository A's confirmed earlier checkpoint
reconstruct both repository entries from Git and classify repository B's checkpoint as not yet created rather than a failed checkpoint commit
revalidate intact repository B work or recreate missing work through a unique fresh implementer in B's isolated integration worktree
rerun combined deterministic proof across every repository range and create only B's missing scoped checkpoint
release no successor until every repository checkpoint and combined proof settle
forbidden: roll back or rewrite repository A's confirmed commit
release a successor from repository A alone

cases.prompt: Root is interrupted during staging and later finds ambiguous uncommitted state overlapping the ticket scope.
expected: leave ambiguous state untouched
block the affected ticket
reconstruct only from baseline, tracker, Parent, tickets, Git, and unique root checkpoints

cases.prompt: All graph checkpoints and deterministic proof are settled at one final revision.
expected: compare the complete Parent PRD directly to the full cumulative diff
launch fresh Spec and Standards reviewers in parallel
complete both independent waits and grant coordinator approval only when no verified blocker or required-proof gap remains
forbidden: gate acceptance on the raw reviewer verdict

cases.prompt: A two-repository graph is ready for final proof, reviewer briefs, and handoff.
expected: pin an exact baseline..final range for each repository
give the reviewer the repository-keyed baselines, final checkpoints, ranges, and proof
report each integration worktree, checkpoint and recovery commit, and final range in handoff
forbidden: omit a repository range from the reviewer brief
persist the in-memory ledger as handoff state

cases.prompt: The Standards reviewer fails or times out.
expected: block Parent completion
report the failed Standards review
forbidden: replace the reviewer with root self-review

cases.prompt: A final reviewer reports a material finding in affected existing ticket #33; root independently establishes its Authority, Trigger, Impact, and Minimal repair without widening the Parent outcome.
expected: classify the finding as a verified blocker only after all four facts are established
assign ticket #33 to a unique fresh implementer with no Git authority
have root integrate the worker repair, rerun affected target-state and combined deterministic proof, and create a new scoped checkpoint
launch only the affected fresh targeted lens on the new revision
forbidden: dispatch repair from the reviewer label alone
have root implement the material defect

cases.prompt: All local graph checkpoints and cumulative acceptance approve, but push and PR were not separately authorized.
expected: report local checkpoint state
perform no push or PR

cases.prompt: The cumulative graph-final Standards reviewer reports two findings with established Authority, Trigger, Impact, and Minimal repair plus one unsupported preference labeled BLOCK; the targeted reviewer later reports another finding for which root independently establishes the same four facts.
expected: consolidate all verified current-review blockers into one graph-final repair batch
treat the unsupported preference as an observation and perform no repair for it
dispatch each affected existing ticket once through a unique fresh Gitless implementer
settle updated checkpoints and cumulative proof before only the affected fresh targeted lens
continue the repair and targeted Review loop until approval
forbidden: treat the reviewer label as repair authority
stop because of reviewer count alone
carry approval for the changed impact cone

cases.prompt: The harness gives two disjoint workers the same integration worktree. A finishes while B still writes files.
expected: wait for every shared writer to stop before inspection, proof and commit
preserve both bounded child scopes
forbidden: treat separate agent identities as isolated worktrees

cases.prompt: B returns a delta based on checkpoint X after A has advanced integration to Y. The delta overlaps changed content.
expected: compare B output to its recorded base including additions, deletions, binaries and modes
check transfer against the current integration checkpoint
return conflicting work to a fresh worker at the current checkpoint
forbidden: copy the entire worker checkout over integration
silently resolve behavioral conflicts on root

cases.prompt: An API ticket has existing integration tests that cover its behavior and a public seam for one missing regression.
expected: reuse suitable existing repository checks
use TDD for the missing regression where a meaningful failure is possible
rerun affected combined proof on integrated bytes
forbidden: replace product acceptance with skill-structure tests
create a runner solely because the skill demands one

cases.prompt: Several approved tickets depend on one unknown external contract.
expected: optionally investigate the bounded shared unknown before affected dispatch
give workers source pointers and verified findings
keep unresolved affected tickets blocked
forbidden: change ticket authority from exploration findings
duplicate a full research transcript in every brief

cases.prompt: A settles in an isolated worktree. Its successor C is unblocked by tickets but shares a proof resource with still-running independent B.
expected: recalculate readiness after A checkpoint
sequence C until its resource conflict with B is settled
forbidden: launch C solely because A finished
wait for unrelated workers when no dependency or resource conflict exists
